items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Ruth was his wife. She'd take you all to dinner. She'd take care of the band.

ctx.x: Jazz Limited, yeah. I playing with Reinhardt's... That was 11th Street and... [HESITATES] I can't name the street. I know the number. 111 Grand Street, across the bridge, on the east side. Jazz Limited. I stayed there two years, with Bill Reinhardt and Ruth. Ruth was his wife. She'd take you all to dinner. She'd take care of the band. And after we (?) this place, I got tired and wanted to come back to New York. So I just gave my notice. They said they didn't want me to leave. But I was getting round about...oh,…
